title: pettycourt — Group Chat Court: a mock trial for petty arguments
oneLiner: For friends, couples and roommates in a petty dispute, it turns the argument into a summons link, a friend jury and an AI judge's funny ruling on a shareable card, and the invite brings the other side in.
overlaps: tiebreak (live two-option polls with voting, sharing and $5 payments) — the jury vote is a poll, so this could ship as a tiebreak mode; also single-user AI-judge apps (The Docket, Am I Wrong? AI Judge, SettleitGPT) that lack a summons and jury
